text: {"question":"How does the inclusion of the DES‑Y6 S8 measurement influence the Hubble‑tension alleviation of the various model groups compared to the effect of fitting the GPAge parameterizations to late‑time data without CMB, and what does this imply about the relative importance of small‑scale clustering versus late‑time expansion data in resolving the tension?","reference_answer":"The DES‑Y6 S8 data tighten constraints on most group E models, raising their Hubble‑tension level by up to 0.7σ, while leaving group R models unchanged and improving group M models.
